Tests.hypothesis: Aimed at poker players who keep losing stacks and want to stop. Inspired by Rival B's coach-story ad (LB-0006): keeps a coach talking to camera, telling the story of one hand, and the free-trial offer; changes the hand and the words to our own and the ending to our app. The story-with-a-coach cell converts better than the exploit's cell (a question over the app screen); the lesson is about the two cells, not either attribute alone
Tests.expected_range: 1.3x to 1.8x T-0001's rate on the same days
Tests.varies: hook question->story; visual app-screen->coach-face (the whole cell)
Tests.good_looks_like: cost per conversion under $1.25 against T-0001's on the same days
